title: Mandatory Tab Name After Icon
description: Add mandatory name after icon of tab. Ensure that tabs are horizontally scrollable.
summary: Added mandatory `name` to `SidePanelTabConfig` and render icon + label in side/mobile panel tabs. Tab strip uses `overflow-x-auto` with `shrink-0` tab buttons for horizontal scrolling. Made `SideTabSpec.label` required and wired `sideTabsToPanelTabs` to map it to `name`. Updated all panel tab consumers (framework, playground, cad, puzzle, sketchpad) with labels/names.
